verses.1: In the twelfth year of the twelfth month, in the twelfth year of our life, the Lord said to me:
verses.2: Son of man, take your face and place it over Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. Then, spread it over him and over all of Egypt.
verses.3: You have spoken and said this: “O Lord Yahweh, I am your Pharaoh, king of Egypt. I am the great ruler who rules over all people. My days are long; they will last forever. For you said to me, ‘My days will be long.’ And so it is.”
verses.4: And I will put hooks in your hearts, and I will fasten your teeth in your jaws. I will lift you up from among your enemies. All of your enemies will be bound in your jaws.
verses.5: And the sea will cast you away, along with all your fish. You will not be able to gather them or keep them alive on earth. And for the sake of the heavens, you will be given over to become food for other creatures.
verses.6: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I, Jehovah, am their Savior, so that they may be blessed in the house of Israel.
verses.7: In your hands, you will be like a prey; you will be torn apart by them. But when they are exhausted, you will be freed from their control, and you will stand before them with all your strength.
verses.8: Therefore, thus said Adonai Yehovah: “I will bring upon you destruction and ruin. I have known from you that man and animals will be destroyed.”
verses.9: And the land of Egypt will become a place of destruction and ruin. They will know that I am Jehovah, because I said so. I will do it, and I will carry out my words.
verses.10: Therefore, I will come to you and to your descendants. I will give you the land of Egypt, so that it may be completely destroyed from the heights of Sinai all the way to the borders of Kush.
verses.11: No human foot shall pass through it, and no animal’s foot shall also pass through it. Nor shall anyone live there for forty years.
verses.12: And I will give the land of Egypt back to its people. It will be restored to those who live in it, and its cities will be rebuilt on top of the ruins. It will be restored after forty years. And I will bring Egypt back into the nations and into their lands again.
verses.13: For thus said Adonai YHWH: “After forty years, I will remove Egypt from among the nations where it has been scattered.”
verses.14: And I restored them to their homeland from Egypt. I brought them back to the land of Patros, from the land of Makhurath. There, they became a humble king.
verses.15: Among the kings, there will be misery and no one will be able to save them from their suffering. They will not be able to escape their troubles at all.
verses.16: And it shall not be allowed for the house of Israel to say, “May there be destruction upon them!” They shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.17: In the twenty-seventh year, at the beginning of one month, there was a message from Jehovah to me.
verses.18: Son of Man, Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, he forced his army to carry out heavy labor. Every head was cut off, and every arm was torn apart. He received no reward for his efforts. And his army also suffered greatly because of the labor they had to carry out.
verses.19: Therefore, thus said Adonai Yehovah: “I will give Nebukadnezar, king of Babylon, the land of Egypt. He will take possession of it and rule over it. And he will be rewarded for his efforts.”
verses.20: The work he did, for which I granted him the land of Egypt. May the Lord, Adonai, bless him.
verses.21: On that day, I will make a covenant with the house of Israel. I will give them a new beginning within their midst, and they will know that I am Jehovah.
